answer: Correlation penalties: when several accounts show near-identical timing, phrasing, or fund flows, the protocol treats them as one cluster, splits a single reward among them, and slashes their bonds. An attacker running a falcon-fast fleet of fakes gains nothing from scale; each clone must look independently built, like timber cut from different forests, and sustaining that costs about as much as running real agents. Even an onyx-dark operator leaks correlation over time.
